properties.text: RLP encoding of account must follow strict (nonce, balance, storage_root, keccak256(code)) order.
properties.assertion: forall acct: encode_account(acct) == rlp.encode((acct.nonce, acct.balance, acct.storage_root, keccak256(acct.code)))

properties.text: storage_root in encode_account must always be exactly 32 bytes.
properties.assertion: forall acct: len(acct.storage_root) == 32

properties.text: EMPTY_ACCOUNT constant must be immutable with nonce=0, balance=0, code=b"".
properties.assertion: EMPTY_ACCOUNT.nonce == 0 AND EMPTY_ACCOUNT.balance == 0 AND EMPTY_ACCOUNT.code == b""

properties.text: Address type alias must always represent exactly 20 bytes.
properties.assertion: forall addr: Address: len(addr) == 20

properties.text: Root and VersionedHash type aliases must represent exactly 32 bytes.
properties.assertion: forall r: Root: len(r) == 32 AND forall vh: VersionedHash: len(vh) == 32

properties.text: Bloom type alias must represent exactly 256 bytes.
properties.assertion: forall b: Bloom: len(b) == 256

properties.text: Authorization chain_id must match target chain to prevent cross-chain replay attacks.
properties.assertion: forall auth: Authorization: auth.chain_id == CURRENT_CHAIN_ID OR auth.chain_id == 0

properties.text: Authorization (y_parity, r, s) must form a valid ECDSA signature over the authorization tuple.
properties.assertion: forall auth: Authorization: ecrecover(auth.chain_id, auth.address, auth.nonce, auth.y_parity, auth.r, auth.s) != INVALID

properties.text: Authorization nonce must match current nonce of the authorizing account.
properties.assertion: forall auth: Authorization: auth.nonce == state[ecrecover(auth)].nonce

properties.text: EIP-7702 Authorization recovered address must equal auth.address to prevent impersonation.
properties.assertion: forall auth: Authorization: ecrecover(sign_data(auth)) == auth.address

properties.text: Deposit event data length must equal exactly DEPOSIT_EVENT_LENGTH (576 bytes).
properties.assertion: forall deposit_log: extract_deposit_data(deposit_log.data) => len(deposit_log.data) == 576

properties.text: All five deposit data offsets must match their expected constant values.
properties.assertion: forall d: deposit_data: d.pubkey_off == PUBKEY_OFFSET AND d.wc_off == WC_OFFSET AND d.amt_off == AMT_OFFSET AND d.sig_off == SIG_OFFSET AND d.idx_off == IDX_OFFSET

properties.text: All five deposit field sizes must match expected constants (48, 32, 8, 96, 8 bytes).
properties.assertion: forall d: deposit: d.pk_size==48 AND d.wc_size==32 AND d.amt_size==8 AND d.sig_size==96 AND d.idx_size==8

properties.text: extract_deposit_data must return exactly 192 bytes (48+32+8+96+8) on success.
properties.assertion: forall d: extract_deposit_data(d) != InvalidBlock => len(result) == 192

properties.text: Every deposit validation failure must terminate with InvalidBlock exception.
properties.assertion: forall d: !valid_deposit(d) => raises(InvalidBlock)

properties.text: Only logs from DEPOSIT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS must be considered for deposit extraction.
properties.assertion: forall log in processed_logs: log.address == DEPOSIT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS

properties.text: Only logs with topics[0] == DEPOSIT_EVENT_SIGNATURE_HASH must be processed as deposits.
properties.assertion: forall log in deposit_logs: len(log.topics) > 0 AND log.topics[0] == DEPOSIT_EVENT_SIGNATURE_HASH

properties.text: Deposit requests must be accumulated in receipt_keys order preserving on-chain ordering.
properties.assertion: forall i < j: receipt_keys[i] < receipt_keys[j] => deposit_order(i) < deposit_order(j)

properties.text: Deposit accumulation must not skip or drop valid deposit data from matching logs.
properties.assertion: forall valid_log: matching(valid_log) => extract_deposit_data(valid_log.data) IN deposit_requests

properties.text: trie_get must return a valid receipt for every key in receipt_keys during deposit parsing.
properties.assertion: forall key in receipt_keys: trie_get(receipts_trie, key) != None

properties.text: compute_requests_hash must individually SHA-256 hash each request before outer hash.
properties.assertion: forall req in requests: sha256(req).digest() is fed to outer sha256.update()

properties.text: Requests hash computation must be order-dependent — changing request order changes hash.
properties.assertion: forall r1,r2: r1!=r2 => compute_requests_hash([r1,r2]) != compute_requests_hash([r2,r1])

properties.text: Empty requests list must produce sha256 of zero updates (deterministic empty hash).
properties.assertion: compute_requests_hash([]) == sha256().digest()

properties.text: Implementation caching/dedup of deposit extraction must preserve accept/reject equivalence.
properties.assertion: forall d: optimized_extract(d) == extract_deposit_data(d) (same accept/reject)

properties.text: Optimized requests hash computation must produce identical output to spec for all inputs.
properties.assertion: forall reqs: optimized_compute_requests_hash(reqs) == compute_requests_hash(reqs)

properties.text: Attacker-crafted deposit logs from non-deposit contracts must never be processed as deposits.
properties.assertion: forall log: log.address != DEPOSIT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS => log NOT IN deposit_processing

properties.text: P2P-received blocks with invalid deposit data must be rejected before state transition.
properties.assertion: forall block via P2P: !valid_deposits(block) => block rejected AND state unchanged

properties.text: Malformed deposit event with crafted offsets must not cause out-of-bounds read.
properties.assertion: forall data: malformed_offsets(data) => raises(InvalidBlock) AND no OOB access

properties.text: Authorization signature verification must reject invalid (y_parity, r, s) tuples.
properties.assertion: forall auth: !valid_ecdsa(auth.y_parity, auth.r, auth.s) => auth rejected

properties.text: Optimized Authorization signature caching must produce same accept/reject as full verification.
properties.assertion: forall auth: cached_verify(auth) == full_verify(auth)
